cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 88% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +1.23% · WTI +2.51% · Brent +2.69% · NatGas -0.03%. 88% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Grid, Storage & Electrification is doing the heavy lifting at +5.10%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Renewables & Solar lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +5.10%; weakest is Renewables & Solar at -0.38%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: BE is the standout at +15.26%
cards.body: Leaders: BE +15.26%, EOSE +14.08%, ARRY +8.14%, VRT +7.43%, FLNC +6.52%. Laggards: FSLR -1.48%, DUK -0.73%, PEG -0.72%, NEE -0.59%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
